lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: Cool glasses, Molly. They really bring that overly complicated outfit together.
: When he compliments the one part of your costume you didn't make yourself T_T
: I have a hard time believing you made that belt. Leatherworking is a difficult skill to master and you're just a teenage girl.
: A teenage girl who has maxed four different leatherworkers on four different servers and you will give me the respect I deserve
: Just kidding, sir. Thank you. I appreciate you not immediately deleting this picture from your phone
: Why would I do that?
: Because you didn't ask for it and you probably think it's weird to be getting something from me out of literally nowhere
: If anything, I'd say you don't send me picture messages enough.
: Since when do you have any interest in pictures of me???? I have millions of cosplay photos that are just consuming space on my phone at this point
: Are you saying I should have been sending those to you all along????
: Yes. That is exactly what I'm saying.
: And just to clarify, you are talking about pictures of me and not all of the pictures I've taken of the OTHER girls cosplaying???
: I mean, I'd accept all of them. But yeah, I'm talking about you.
: Sir, are you just nicer through text? Because I can relate to that and if it's not a problem we can just talk like this from now on
: I'm honestly more comfortable like this anyway. It's easier to be confident when you can just backspace all of your negative thoughts!
: I'd prefer to still talk in person if that's cool. Phones are good for receiving nudes and that's pretty much it.
: O_O
: I don't know if I'm ready to send those just yet sir
: I'm not asking you to. Just clarifying my stance in regard to cell phones.
: Then I am inclined to disagree, sir. I have many fond memories of playing games on my phone and.......absolutely none of having ever received nudes from anyone.
: Unless you count the ones the Magistrate has sent to me on accident.
: I'm not sure if those were actually accidents, Molly.
: Oh yay. That makes me feel a lot better about what I proceeded to do with them.
: I mean what
: What happened to backspacing your negative thoughts?
: Nothing happened sir. I'm a good girl who sees her boss as a boss.
: I'm not sure if I believe that after seeing what you've done with pictures of your coworkers.
: PLEASE FORGET THAT ALREADY. THE DOOR SHOULD HAVE BEEN LOCKED.
: No door is ever locked for me. It's just the way the world works.
: DAMN H-GAME PROTAGONISTS AND THEIR SEX-VISION.
: Though I'd be lying if I said I was not envious of your powers, sir. I don't blame you at all for collecting as many CGs as you can.
: Thanks. I think.
: Don't mention it! Now please excuse me as I finish editing Kafka's pictures.
: Who?
: You will see soon, sir!
: What am I looking at exactly?
: Ginger wolf!
: Or, more accurately Silver Wolf. A character from Honkai Star Rail, miHoYo's latest game. Not to be confused with Honkai Impact, which is the game we took our costumes from last year.
: Neat.
: You aren't actually interested at all, are you sir?
: No, but I'm glad you found something you can be passionate about. All I have is porn.
: Well then you're in luck sir because the miHoYo games have a TON of that. Which means that you should have at least some interest in our costumes by proxy
: Are you telling me that I can go online and look up porn for the character you're dressed as right now?
: Rule 34 sir. If it exists, there is porn of it. And rule 34 section 9c is that, if it's a miHoYo property, there's even more of it.
: You'd be better off with one of the other costumes I've done, though. Star Rail is still relatively new, so the porn catalogue isn't exactly as populated as it will be a year from now.
: And what was the character's name again?
: Just scroll up sir.
: Just tell me again. My dominant hand is too occupied to scroll right now and typing is hard enough.
: Have you...already gotten started? Before even looking anything up?
: I have a problem, Molly.
: As do I, sir. But I'm inclined to call this determination rather than anything detrimental to your health. I applaud your ingenuity and my mind is definitely not wandering right now.
: The character's name. What was it and what do I type in?
: Silver Wolf, sir. Search on Pixiv. It's the ultimate repository.
: Are you actually doing this right now?
: Wow, you weren't kidding. There's a lot on here.
: You wouldn't...have any interest in perhaps facetiming me right now, would you?
: Can't. Busy.
: I understand that, but if I'm able to help in some way...
: And I'm done.
: Done???
: Yeah.
: Already?!?!
: I got a head start.
: By how long?! You didn't respond until a few minutes ago!
: I got started the moment you sent this picture to me.
: O_O
: You're kidding
: Right???
: Did you actually???
: Anyway, see you later. Thanks for the porn recommendation. Feel free to send more pictures whenever.
: Molly, don't take this the wrong way, but you are so fucking hot.
: Like, really. Just look at the way you're carrying yourself here. You're so confident and comfortable and you're really just extraordinarily attractive.
: Okay, Ami. You can give Sensei the phone back now
: This isn't Ami.
: Ayane?
: Nope.
: Well, who else would go out of their way to boost my morale like this? Because it sure wouldn't be Rin
: Me. Your teacher. The owner of this phone.
: And who put you up to this exactly? Because you have never been the type to openly express any amount of adoration for me at all sir
: No one put me up to this. I just wanted you to know how attractive I think you are and that, despite my actions, I still fantasize about impregnating you
: Okay now I know it's not Sensei. Very funny Ami. I'm sorry for sending your uncle a picture message. But IN MY DEFENSE I'd send yours too if you joined us this year
: Again, this isn't Ami. This is your teacher. Just expressing his interest in wanting to impregnate a teenage girl via text message.
: THIS ISN'T FUNNY ANYMORE
: Probably because it's not a joke, Molly. Let me say something nice about you for once.
: How am I supposed to respond right now if I don't know who I'm actually talking to?!?! Saying anything at all could incriminate me in some way!
: Incriminate you for what exactly?
: See! Now you're probing me for information! I'm sorry! I'll stop sending him pictures! I just thought he'd like the costume and the photo came out really well!
: It sure did. Please send more of them.
: FINE I'LL STAY AWAY FOREVER AND NEVER COSPLAY AGAIN
: Molly, it's fine. Really. I just want you to know you're beautiful because I know you struggle with your confidence at times.
: GOODBYE AMI I AM TURNING OFF MY PHONE NOW
